captions.detailed: A dark gray/black giant observation porro-prism binocular mounted on a heavy-duty pedestal stand. It features two large cylindrical objective barrels connected to a central hinge mechanism with a focusing wheel, supported by a rectangular mounting fork. The entire binocular assembly is designed to pan horizontally on a vertical revolute joint at the pedestal head, tilt vertically via a clutch joint on the fork arm, and adjust the interpupillary distance via the central barrel hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a giant observation binocular on a pedestal mount. The model should include a circular base with a tall cylindrical pedestal column, a mounting fork, a central pan joint rotating on a vertical axis, a tilt joint for vertical elevation, and twin cylindrical objective barrels joined by a central hinge with a focus wheel.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly starting with a pedestal base and vertical column using Cylinder primitives. A mounting fork is created using a combination of Box and Cylinder primitives to form the yoke. The binocular body is built from two large cylindrical barrels (Cylinder primitives) connected to a central hinge axle. A series of revolute joints are defined using the custom Articulation class, linking the pedestal to the fork (pan axis), the fork to the binocular body (tilt axis), and the two barrels to each other (interpupillary adjustment).
